The tank capacity is 50 gallons. We have 10 liters. 10 liters is about 2.64 gallons. So we need to fill to full? The user says "fill up the tank". That implies fill to full. So we need to call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount equal to capacity minus current. But we don\'t know current fuel level in gallons. We have 10 liters. Convert to gallons: 10 liters * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So remaining capacity: 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount ~47.36 gallons. But the function expects a float. We\'ll round to maybe 47.36. Let\'s do that.')
